studies.title: Charts of sticks and shells
studies.caption: Marshallese navigators tie palm ribs and shells into frames that show how ocean swells bend and cross around islands.
studies.prompt: Close overhead view of a Marshallese navigator teaching on shore around1850, fingers resting on a rectangular open lattice of thin curved palm ribs lashed together, a few small shells tied at intersections. Pattern encodes swells, not a geographic map; no chart being used while steering at sea.
